_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
We u Player {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe ya Vanu Vatu.
Ovite ovayo ni '{symbol}'.
We uzinga mukanda wo kufeka ovite ovayo pa tchiboko ya 5x5 kuunda mstari wa ne.
Mistari inaweza kuwa ya ndunda, ya kusimama, kana ya diagonal.
Tuma movi ovayo uzinga mu njila ya '[4]' ku marka selu 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ocimunga caco ka ci tava oku ci pongolola. Kuami onumbi yokuti "[cell]" apa ocimatamata 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ombala ili kweli: {cell}. Ili shimu po 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Mwene {player_id} uukala ondjala ili na oshili.

game_action.placed: Mwene {player_id} uukala iisimbo shyu ({symbol}) mu ningo ({row}, {col}).
